File:Frankfurt Central Business District.jpg
desc:
This image show the central Business district of the German city Frankfurt am main at daytime. 
It has been taken from the top of the Frankfurt cathedral. Towards the bottom you can see the main square and town hall, behind which you can see the Paulskirche.
